reviews.x: I hate tying my locs up at night. My scalp gets too hot and starts to itch profusely. I decided to try this stocking cap because it's thin and would allow air to get to my scalp. I really like it. My scalp doesn't itch when I wear it.  It fits nicely and it was able to stretch enough to fit all of my locs. What I like most about it is that it's thin and when I wear it in the shower my locs can reap the benefits of the steam without getting wet.
If you have long dreads, this product is very useful and durable along with affordable. It needs to come in more of a variety of colors.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cap useful for sleeping and keeping locs or long hair in place, and several praise its lightweight, comfortable fit.
Some reviewers report the elastic is not tight enough to stay on the head, with the cap slipping off at night or stretching out around the edges over time.
A few reviewers note durability problems, including seams coming apart and lint or string pieces getting caught in locs.
Reviewers frequently mention good value and speedy delivery, with some buying multiple caps or wanting more colors.
One reviewer warns to wash the cap several times before wearing due to strong dye.
